text:
### Reporting  
**Monthly Report:**
- Fraud incidents reported
- Loss amount
- Detection method
- Trend analysis  
**Quarterly Report to Risk Committee:**
- Fraud risk assessment
- Top fraud types/patterns
- Process improvements implemented
- Fraud prevention effectiveness

raw_entities.name: Fraud Reporting Policy
raw_entities.description: A policy governing the mandatory reporting of fraud incidents and fraud risk assessments at monthly and quarterly intervals. The policy requires documentation of fraud incidents, loss amounts, detection methods, trend analysis, and effectiveness metrics to be reported to the Risk Committee.
context: Monthly Report: Fraud incidents reported, Loss amount, Detection method, Trend analysis
Quarterly Report to Risk Committee: Fraud risk assessment, Top fraud types/patterns, Process improvements implemented, Fraud prevention effectiveness

raw_entities.name: Monthly Fraud Incident Reporting
raw_entities.description: A mandatory requirement to report fraud incidents on a monthly basis, including the incident count, associated loss amounts, the detection method used, and trend analysis.
context: Monthly Report: Fraud incidents reported, Loss amount, Detection method, Trend analysis

raw_entities.name: Quarterly Fraud Risk Assessment Reporting
raw_entities.description: A mandatory requirement to submit a quarterly fraud risk assessment to the Risk Committee, detailing the top fraud types and patterns, process improvements implemented, and metrics on fraud prevention effectiveness.
context: Quarterly Report to Risk Committee: Fraud risk assessment, Top fraud types/patterns, Process improvements implemented, Fraud prevention effectiveness

raw_entities.name: Risk Committee
raw_entities.description: A governance body responsible for receiving and reviewing quarterly fraud risk assessments, including fraud risk evaluations, top fraud patterns, process improvements, and fraud prevention effectiveness metrics.
context: Quarterly Report to Risk Committee: Fraud risk assessment, Top fraud types/patterns, Process improvements implemented, Fraud prevention effectiveness

raw_entities.name: Fraud
raw_entities.description: The primary risk category addressed by this reporting policy, encompassing fraud incidents, fraud types, fraud patterns, and fraud prevention effectiveness. The policy requires systematic monitoring and reporting of fraud occurrences and loss amounts.
